title: Decide actual enabled weakly-reversible reachability using the ordinary reaction ideal
statement: For I=<z^y-z^yprime> over Q, monomial multiples z^rho(z^y-z^yprime) are exactly differences of enabled undirected population edges. Component coefficient-sum functionals annihilate I, and finite path telescoping gives z^a-z^b in I iff a,b belong to the same undirected component. Weak reversibility realizes each reverse population edge by its directed complex cycle at the same nonnegative residual, so this is the actual reachable closed class. Finite rational Groebner normal forms decide membership. Positive rates suffice for the graph statement, which proves neither stochastic nonexplosion nor recurrence.
